status: DRAFT - drafted by the reviewer (Claude) on 2026-09-27 from two research runs. The MAINTAINER commits it. Agents build the loader and must not change any value; they propose changes only under ## Blocked. null means unknown: never fill a null with a guess.

tiers.literature: A published table exists for this material in printed lattice form (today: varioShore only, Iacob 2024).
tiers.proxy_candidate: Solid printed-material data exists, so a lattice response COULD be estimated by scaling another material's table. Whether proxies are allowed at all is open question Q4 - until ruled, treat as calibrate_first.
tiers.calibrate_first: No usable lattice data. Offered for geometry only; no squish prediction until in-house coupons exist.

error_band_defaults.note: Fraction of predicted squish depth. Research: calibrated curves give about +/-15-25 %; literature curves applied to another printer/spool about +/-30-50 %. varioShore is process-sensitive (non-monotonic in temperature), so its literature band sits at the wide end.

varioshore_tpu.offered_temps_note: ONLY the three temperatures Iacob tested. Stiffness is NOT monotonic in temperature (190 > 240 > 220 C), so never interpolate between temperatures.

tpu95a_generic.display_name: TPU 95A (Bambu 95A HF, Polymaker PolyFlex TPU95, eSUN, Elegoo ...)
tpu95a_generic.note: The most-used flexible and the one with the least TABULATED lattice data: Chatpun 2025 (PolyFlex TPU95, 14-20 % infill) and Li 2026 (95A, 30-70 % gyroid) are figures only. First target of coupon set A. Maintainer to fill temps and speeds from the brand he prints.

ninjaflex_85a.nozzle_temp_note: Range tested by Gallup 2025, not the manufacturer's recommendation. Printed modulus roughly DOUBLES from 225 to 250 C in infill-only coupons (8.14 -> 17.63 MPa).
ninjaflex_85a.hyperelastic_constants: hyperelastic_constants_printed_tpu.csv (Gallup 2025 Mooney-Rivlin by temperature; Reppel 2018 Ogden)

peba_85a.display_name: PEBA 85A (Siraya Rebound PEBA 85A; Xinbo PEBA 85A in Li 2026)
peba_85a.note: Li 2026: softest of eTPU / TPU / PEBA in gyroid at every density tested (figures only).

esun_tpu_lw.hardness_note: eSUN states 93A -> 77A and 220 C = minimal foam, 260 C = maximum; pairing the endpoints this way is the reviewer's reading, not a published table.
esun_tpu_lw.note: Manufacturer: one uniform speed for all features; disable first-layer and small-area slowdown; avoid long runs above 250 C on PTFE-lined hotends. Max foaming volume 172 % (store) vs 200 % (eSUN page) - conflict.

siraya_tpu_air.flow_note: Manufacturer says 55-60 % around 260 C; 57.5 is the midpoint, not a published value.
siraya_tpu_air.note: Hardness ranges are inconsistent across Siraya pages (blog 78A -> 63A; product page 65A-82A).

siraya_peba_air.hardness_note: Manufacturer table was derived with a 0.6 mm nozzle; a 0.4 mm nozzle foams less.

siraya_roamr_tpu_air_hr.display_name: Siraya Tech Roamr TPU Air HR 85A (foaming, high rebound)
siraya_roamr_tpu_air_hr.note: Separate 0.4 and 0.6 mm nozzle tables in the user guide - transcribe them before offering this material.

drying.method: oven; or 80-90 C for 12 h on the heatbed

excluded_v1.filaflex_foamy: Community data only (severe under-extrusion reported at 250 C / 65 % flow). Not offered.
excluded_v1.bambu_foaming_tpu: No Bambu-branded foaming TPU could be confirmed in the research. Do not list one.
